metadata.description: Public AI agent plugins for Codex (Agent Plugins format). Add with `codex plugin marketplace add Teebor-Choka/skills`.

plugins.name: swe-workflows
plugins.description: The engineered per-task SWE workflow: the implement skill plus a policy-gate hook enforcing the repo's .agents/policy at commit/ready/integrate. The skill also reaches Codex via .agents/skills; this plugin adds the native hook. Needs the `harness` plugin (`harness:policy`, ai/harness) for the policy loader.
